purpose: Freeze the executable semantic contract for ClayCode BASE so parser/compiler/runtime work can converge without continuing semantic redesign. This is a BASE implementation freeze, not a claim that the compiler/runtime gate has passed.
frozen_laws: effect.commit requires independently valid capability possession and witnesses
state truth and graph relevance remain distinct
conflict/unknown/revocation are preserved rather than silently collapsed
semantic identity is distinct from runtime state-version/trace identity where the contract distinguishes them
language semantics change only when an executable application/compiler counterexample forces the change
general-purpose expressibility may be realized through typed lowering/FFI; safety constrains authority rather than computational expressibility

required_before_wp02_pass: full admitted G9 + Dialect frontend receipt
deterministic canonical roundtrip/hash receipt with mutation discrimination

candidate_disposition_rule.rule: Any ClayCode/XENO/FRANK language candidate not explicitly listed in authority_order is NOT_SELECTED_FOR_BASE_FREEZE unless an executable counterexample is recorded and this freeze is amended by a new version. Historical evidence and negative results remain preserved in repository history/ledgers.
amendment_requires: regression tests proving the delta is required
